note: BH-6495: with conductor_workers_on_fly on, a merge-conductor-pr lane_runs row that no lane-run machine has claimed this many seconds after it was enqueued makes the hub run that PR itself this tick (fallback=no-capacity), so a missing or full fleet never stops merges. 600 matches the ticket's 'row unclaimed for more than 10 min' rollback line. A machine that claims the row later lands nothing (MC_ON_MACHINE).
